title_lines: A MOUNTAIN LAKE 🏔️💧 The fishermen say the deepest water
sings the lowest song — notes below A440, under the waterline.
Row out and find the very bottom of the valley. 🛶🎧
question: Which sound is the deepest point of the lake? 🛶
hint_lines: At the very bottom, each ring of musicians sings ONE note in unison —
and every ring outward is higher. Nobody sings below the middle. 💡
Deep water sits BELOW A440 — listen for the whole chord hanging low.

options.label: B
options.explain: That was a SUMMIT — every voice fell away below you. We want the mirror image: the place where every voice rises above. 🙂

options.label: C
options.explain: That was the SHORELINE — low voices over the water, high voices toward the land. Keep rowing toward the low side! 🙂

options.label: D
options.explain: Every musician sang one middle note — flat ground at A440, no valley anywhere. 🙂

success_text: THE DEEPEST POINT! 💙 Every ring in unison, everything rising around you, the whole chord below A440 — a MINIMUM. You just heard negative numbers. 🎉🛶
